:box:In `1942`, President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order `9066`. The order authorized the removal of people of Japanese ancestry from what the U.S. government designated as military areas in the United States.

In `1944`, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in Korematsu v. United States that the detention of people of Japanese ancestry was a “military necessity.”

In `1988`, President Ronald Reagan signed the Civil Liberties Act of 1988, which declared “a grave injustice was done to citizens and permanent resident aliens of Japanese ancestry by the evacuation, relocation, and internment of civilians during World War `text(II)`.” Survivors of the detention camps were paid restitution.

In `2018`, the U.S. Supreme Court rebuked the `1944` Korematsu decision and stated that it no longer had the force of precedent: “The forcible relocation of U.S. citizens to concentration camps, solely and explicitly on the basis of race, is objectively unlawful and outside the scope of Presidential authority.”
Which `ultext(two)` sentences most likely explain the government’s initial actions and later actions regarding the internment of Japanese citizens?

A.Choice: Initial actions of the government were influenced by restrictive immigration policies.

B.Choice: Later actions of the government were influenced by the expansion of suffrage rights.

C.Choice: Later actions of the government were influenced by the passage of time and thoughtful reflection.

Key.Rationale: Later actions of the government were influenced by the passage of time and thoughtful reflection.

D.Choice: Initial actions of the government were influenced by racism and the circumstances of a major event.

Key.Rationale: Initial actions of the government were influenced by racism and the circumstances of a major event.

E.Choice: Later actions of the government were influenced by the role of women in the workforce and the need for wartime labor.

:box:`ultext(Some Features of the Articles of Confederation, 1781)`

• `text(Each state)` retains any powers not expressly listed in the Articles.
• The nation is a “league of friendship” whose states will help protect each other from attacks.
• People can travel freely among the states.
• `text(Each state)` gets one vote in Congress.
• The central government is responsible for international relations.
• States must maintain a militia but cannot have a standing army.
• States will raise their own money to send to the central government.
Based on the information in the box, which phrase `ultext(best)` describes the intended purpose of the Articles of Confederation?

A.Choice: to create a uniform code of laws that all states would adhere to and to create a national culture

B.Choice: to create a plan of governing the nation that would enforce national laws and collect necessary taxes

C.Choice: to create a plan of government that would make peace treaties with international powers and ensure national security

D.Choice: to create a nation where states have most of the power and work together to avoid a too-powerful central government

Key.Rationale: The intended purpose of the Articles of Confederation was to create a nation where states have most of the power and work together to avoid a too powerful central government.

:box:In the `text(mid-1800s)`, Europeans learned of the many resources of Africa. From `1880` until `1914`, European countries competed to claim parts of Africa. This became known as the scramble for Africa. In `1885`, `text(fourteen)` European nations met to divide up the continent. This division paid little attention to natural boundaries or cultural borders. After World War `text(II)`, most European nations gave up their land in Africa and the countries became independent. As the European powers left the continent, old tribal conflicts resurfaced. Many civil wars were fought, and new nations were created.
Which statement best describes an `ultext(unintentional)` consequence of the European withdrawal from Africa after World War `text(II)`?

A.Choice: European traditions became embedded in African society.

B.Choice: Conflict among tribal groups seeking power led to political instability.

Key.Rationale: Conflict among tribal groups seeking power led to political instability.

C.Choice: Tribal groups provided improved protection of local natural resources.

D.Choice: The influence of African governments changed the structure of European governments.

:box:`ultext(Nature versus Nurture)`

Nature and nurture both influence human traits and characteristics. Nature refers to traits that are inherited from a person’s biological parents, while nurture refers to the effects of experiences and learning in a person’s environment. Today, psychologists believe that both nature and nurture interact to contribute to a person’s development.

• To expand Medicaid programs to cover more adults who meet low-income measures

Content: Read the excerpt from the U.S. Supreme Court decision in Brown v. Board of Education of Topeka.

:box:Segregation of white and [African American] children in public schools has a detrimental effect upon the [African American] children. Content: After the Spanish-American War, the United States came into possession of the Philippines.
Which quotation about the Spanish-American War `ultext(best)` exemplifies the concept of ethnocentrism?

A.Choice: Senator Alfred Beveridge: “For the conflicts of the future are to be conflicts of trade, struggles for markets, commercial wars for existence.”

B.Choice: Mark Twain: “The funniest thing was when at the close of the Spanish-American War the United States paid poor decrepit old Spain `text($20,000,000)` for the Philippines. It was just a case of this country buying its way into good society.”

C.Choice: President William McKinley: “[There] was nothing left for us to do but to take them all, and to educate the Filipinos, and uplift and civilize and Christianize them, and by God’s grace do the very best we could by them, as our fellow-men.”

Key.Rationale: The quotation from President William McKinley about the Spanish-American War exemplifies the concept of ethnocentrism: “[There] was nothing left for us to do but to take them all, and to educate the Filipinos, and uplift and civilize and Christianize them, and by God’s grace do the very best we could by them, as our fellow-men.”

D.Choice: William Howard Taft: “Now, what is meant by the principle, ‘the Philippines for the Filipinos’? Only this, that `text(every measure)`, whether in the form of law or an executive order, before its adoption, should be weighed in the light of this question: Does it make for the welfare of the Filipino people, or does it not?”
